title: Hold an on-demand booking service authorisation
what: Hold an on-demand booking service authorisation before providing an on-demand (taxi or rideshare) booking service.

sources.title: Transport (Road Passenger Services) Act 2018 (WA)
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if — (a) the person provides an on-demand booking service; and (b) the person does not hold an on-demand booking service authorisation that is in force and authorises the provision of that service.
